title: Shots (canonical shot segmentation)
description: Canonical shot boundary list — the authoritative segmentation shared by every downstream stage. Top-level JSON array, contiguous from t=0 to source duration with no gaps. Producer: detectors/detect_v3b.py:main (writes shots.json); Consumers: audio/separate_stems.py:analyze_shots, html/gen_timeline_html.py:build_shots_js.

id.description: 1-based shot index, monotonically increasing across the array.

start_sec.description: Shot start time in seconds (inclusive). First shot starts at 0.0.

end_sec.description: Shot end time in seconds (exclusive). Must equal the next shot's start_sec.

duration.description: Shot duration in seconds. Must equal end_sec - start_sec and be > 0.
